verdict.rationale: AgentMail supplies event-driven building blocks: registrable webhooks and WebSockets that notify your own code when email events happen. The background automation logic, however, runs in the user's own agent or in third-party platforms such as Sim. The evidence shows no first-party feature for defining automations that the product runs autonomously, so these primitives earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: you can register a URL, and we will send you a `POST` request with the details as soon as an event happens.
